quote: Let's talk about why Bitcoin even exists in 2008 the global financial system collapsed. Banks got bailed out regular people got left behind. Bitcoin was born in 2009 as a direct response. It's a new kind of financial system one that doesn't rely on trust in banks, governments or institutions with Bitcoin you don't need permission to use it you can send it across borders in minutes and no one can freeze or censor your funds. Bitcoin is freedom money. It puts you in control.
